scope: Plan-only review: saved JSON schema, exact request/copy/conditions, requested count, role/ratio mapping, complete fullcopy, valid cross-role comparison, and a manual comparison of proposed action visibility and information space. No generated poster or actual rendered typography was inspected.

assets.note: Both exact role asset arrays are empty; no image file or manifest was supplied in case.json.

manual_plan_review.shared_product: Both directions retain the same stated matte black aluminum body, one silver pivot, two black rubber pads, short upper lever and opposing jaws; only camera and composition differ. No supplied product asset exists to compare.
manual_plan_review.actual_content_relation: M1 starts with index pressure and follows the lever–pivot–jaw chain. M2 starts at the open receiving gap and follows the memo plane back to the pressing index.
manual_plan_review.substantial_non_glyph_visual: Each proposed poster uses a large single photographed-use scene of the clip, one hand and one memo sheet; this is a design specification, not visual verification.
manual_plan_review.typography_and_information: M1 places copy beside the corresponding stages of the horizontal mechanism. M2 uses the memo plane for the main information and keeps the entry edge clear; its material copy sits beside the body. These different spatial relationships were reviewed together.
manual_plan_review.feasibility_limits: The proposed camera angles explicitly expose lever, pivot, both jaws/pads and paper entry edge. No physical prototype, motion test, rendered type, actual image resolution, use-size readability or print suitability was verified.

actual_image_verification.reason: User requested planning only and prohibited image generation and editing.
